Package org.ether.society.engines.tier2.historical

package org.ether.society.engines.tier2.historical

Tier 2: Historical Empirical Benchmark & Episode Simulation Engines

Contains specialized engines capturing specific historical phenomena, transition episodes, and empirical test cases across world history:

  • LateBronzeAgeCollapseEngine: 1200 BCE Eastern Mediterranean multi-causal systemic collapse.
  • RomanInflationFiscalEngine: 3rd-century CE debasement, fiscal extraction, and military expenditure crisis.
  • JustinianPlagueClimateEngine: 536 CE volcanic winter and Yersinia pestis mortality wave.
  • MayaDroughtPolityEngine: Terminal Classic Megadroughts and Mesoamerican decentralization.
  • BlackDeathLaborEngine: 1348 CE demographic shock and agrarian real-wage reconfiguration.
  • EdoJapanIsolationEngine: Sakoku autarky, forest conservation, and demographic stabilization.
  • RwandanMalthusianPressureEngine: 20th-century micro-land fragmentation and ecological stress.
  • World3PureEngine & World3HybridEngine: Meadows et al. Club of Rome Limit to Growth dynamics.
